title: Equity Bar Record Schema
description: Canonical OHLCV bar record for equities (MSTR, SPY, QQQ). Research-only. Vendor-neutral, provider-independent. Defines the single-source-of-truth record shape used by all downstream processes. The symbol set is a research-domain constraint, not an executable allowlist. No data collection, ingestion, or storage is authorized by this schema alone.

schema_version.description: Schema version string. Always '0.1' for records conforming to this schema.

record_id.description: Globally unique record identifier. Format: {instrument_id}-{event_timestamp_utc}-{provider_role_id}-{provider_record_id}. Used for deterministic deduplication.

raw_record_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical serialization of this record's governed data fields (excluding metadata like revision_number and ingestion_timestamp_utc). Used for immutability verification.

provider_role_id.description: Provider role identifier registered in MSTR_BTC_PROVIDER_GOVERNANCE_v0_1.json. e.g. primary_equity_bar, fallback_equity_bar.

provider_record_id.description: Provider-assigned record identifier. The provider's own unique key for this record, preserved verbatim for audit reconciliation.

instrument_id.description: Canonical instrument identifier. Format: {symbol}@{venue}.{asset_class}, e.g. MSTR@NASDAQ.equity.

asset_class.description: Asset class. Always 'equity' for this schema.

research_track.description: Research track assignment. A dataset belongs to exactly one research track. Track A and Track B records must not be silently combined into one dataset.

execution_eligible.description: Must be false. No equity bar record is executable. This schema is research-only.

event_timestamp_utc.description: Bar close timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. For daily bars, this is the market-close timestamp for that trading day.

source_timestamp_utc.description: Provider-asserted timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. Represents when the provider claims the bar closed or was published. Must be distinct from ingestion_timestamp_utc.

ingestion_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z', when this record was received and written. Must be strictly >= source_timestamp_utc. Generated by the ingestion runtime, not the provider.

available_at_utc.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z', at which this record became available for model consumption. Models may use a record only when available_at_utc is not later than the evaluation as-of timestamp. Enforces point-in-time temporal integrity.

revision_number.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter for this record_id. Initial ingestion is revision 1. Corrections increment the revision. Later revisions must not rewrite an immutable earlier raw record — a new revision record is created with the same record_id but incremented revision_number.

is_final.description: True when this revision is the final, corrected version of the record. False when further revisions are expected. Only is_final=true records may be used in backtest evaluation windows.

data_quality_state.description: Quality state after quality engine evaluation. PASSED = all checks passed. FLAGGED = soft warnings present but usable. DEGRADED = quality score below full-confidence threshold but above minimum. REJECTED = HARD_FAIL — record must not be used.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol. Upper-case. Must be one of: MSTR, SPY, QQQ. Exchange suffix not included here — use venue for disambiguation.

venue.description: Exchange or market-center code. e.g. NASDAQ, NYSE, ARCA. Required for provider reconciliation.

currency.description: Quote currency. Always 'USD' for this research domain.

bar_interval.description: Bar interval. Primary resolution for MSTR/BTC research is '1day'. Intraday bars below 15min require separate approval.

session_type.description: Trading session type captured by this bar. REGULAR = regular trading hours only. COMBINED = regular + extended. Different session types must not be silently mixed.

open.description: Opening price for the bar period.

high.description: Highest price during the bar period. Must be >= max(open, close) and >= low.

low.description: Lowest price during the bar period. Must be <= min(open, close) and <= high.

close.description: Closing price for the bar period.

volume.description: Traded volume in shares for the bar period. Must never be negative.

trade_count.description: Number of trades executed during the bar period. Required when the provider supplies it. A count of zero with positive volume is a data-quality anomaly.

vwap.description: Volume-weighted average price for the bar period. Required when the provider supplies it. If present, must lie within [low, high].

adjusted.description: True if prices and volume are adjusted for corporate actions (splits, dividends). False if raw/unadjusted. Adjusted and unadjusted records must not be silently mixed in the same dataset.

adjustment_version.description: Required when adjusted=true. Identifies the adjustment methodology and version. A changed adjustment history creates a new version. e.g. 'split-adjusted-v2.1', 'dividend-adjusted-v1.0'.

corporate_action_state.description: Corporate action adjustment state for this bar. NONE = no adjustments applied. MULTIPLE_ADJUSTMENTS = more than one type of adjustment is active.

quote_condition.description: Market quote condition during this bar period. NORMAL = standard trading. HALTED bars must be explicitly marked and excluded from signal computation.

bar_completion_state.description: Bar completion state. COMPLETE = bar period is fully closed and data is final. PARTIAL = bar period is still in progress. PRELIMINARY = bar is closed but subject to correction. CORRECTED = previously published bar has been corrected. Incomplete bars (PARTIAL, PRELIMINARY) must remain explicitly marked and must not be treated as COMPLETE.

high_ge_low.description: High must be >= low. Violation renders the bar invalid for all downstream use.

prices_positive.rule: open > 0 AND high > 0 AND low > 0 AND close > 0
prices_positive.description: All price fields must be strictly positive.

source_le_ingestion.description: Source timestamp must not be later than ingestion timestamp.

available_not_later_than_ingestion.description: Available timestamp must not be later than ingestion timestamp.

timestamps_rfc3339_utc_z.rule: All timestamp fields must end with 'Z' (RFC 3339 UTC). No offset notation (+00:00) permitted — 'Z' suffix only.
timestamps_rfc3339_utc_z.description: All timestamp fields must be in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'.

timestamp_not_future.description: Timestamps must not be in the future beyond a small clock-skew tolerance.

no_timestamp_substitution.rule: source_timestamp_utc, event_timestamp_utc, ingestion_timestamp_utc, and available_at_utc must remain distinct fields with documented meanings. No timestamp may be silently substituted for another.

incomplete_bar_marked.rule: IF bar_completion_state IN ('PARTIAL', 'PRELIMINARY') THEN data_quality_state must not be PASSED
incomplete_bar_marked.description: Incomplete bars must remain explicitly marked. They must never be treated as COMPLETE.

adjusted_unadjusted_no_silent_mix.rule: Within a single dataset, all records must have the same adjusted flag and adjustment_version. Adjusted and unadjusted records must not be silently mixed.

adjustment_has_version.rule: IF adjusted == true THEN adjustment_version IS NOT NULL AND adjustment_version IS NOT EMPTY
adjustment_has_version.description: Adjusted bars must carry an adjustment_version.

changed_adjustment_new_version.rule: A changed adjustment history (different adjustment_version) creates a new dataset version. It must not silently overwrite the prior version.

duplicate_detection.rule: Duplicate records (same record_id, same raw_record_hash) must be detected deterministically. The first record with a given record_id at revision 1 is the immutable raw record.

execution_eligible_false.description: All equity bar records are research-only. execution_eligible must be false.

symbol_in_research_set.description: Only MSTR, SPY, QQQ are authorized for this research schema.

stale_or_unavailable_no_trade.rule: IF required bars for the evaluation window are stale or unavailable THEN produce NO_TRADE
stale_or_unavailable_no_trade.description: Stale or unavailable required bars result in NO_TRADE.

no_broker_fields.rule: No broker IDs, order IDs, account IDs, execution IDs, approval IDs, H1 fields, credentials, tokens, or endpoint URLs may appear in any record.
